name: Khone
description: Forest kingdom turned into a swamp and destroyed by Sol'Kanar.

description_citations.text: "Sol'Kanar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gydolien takes control of Sivitri's dragon, which returns through the portal with Sivitri; Sol'Kanar orders Gydolien's home Khone scoured.
timeline.quote: Gydolien intervened by taking control of Sivitri's dragon, instructing it to leave.

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada twists Sol'Kanar into her minion, turns Khone into a swamp, and he wages war in her name.
timeline.quote: She turned Khone into a large swamp

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Minion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar moves to Sulgh and becomes its leader, demanding annual tribute.
timeline.quote: became the undisputed leader of the land

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar, Chondeah and Gydolien summon a Scarzam Dragon ridden by Sivitri, who attacks him; Gydolien forces them back and Sol'Kanar destroys Khone in a rage.
timeline.quote: destroyed the kingdom of Khone in a rage

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar submerges the caravan path between Khone and Shikar and uses it as leverage to demand tribute.
timeline.quote: By deliberately submerging this critical trade artery beneath the waters of his swamp

citation.text: "Date of Tribute", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Khone and Shikar must send regular offerings under threat of destruction, and are called the Contrary Kingdoms.
timeline.quote: the two kingdoms were compelled to send regular offerings directly to him

citation.text: "Date of Tribute", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar sides with treacherous Khone in the Dragon War and destroys the city of Shikar.
timeline.quote: Sol'Kanar took the side of treacherous Khone, and destroyed the city of Shikar

citation.text: "Great Salt Marsh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada twists Khone into a swamp and binds its spirit as Sol'Kanar.
timeline.quote: until it was twisted into a swamp by Geyadrone Dihada and its spirit was bound to her service as Sol'Kanar the Swamp King

citation.text: "Khone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar forces the kingdoms to send tribute until the Dragon War.
timeline.quote: forced the inhabitants to send slaves and goods on the Date of Tribute

citation.text: "Khone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chondaeh boils the swamp, killing everyone in Khone but Gydolien Mor; Sol'Kanar retreats.
timeline.quote: killing everyone there, with Gydolien Mor as the only survivor

citation.text: "Khone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: By 4196 AR Khone is rebuilt as a small realm ruled by House Jet.
timeline.quote: Khone had been rebuilt as a small realm ruled by House Jet

citation.text: "Khone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
